title: Doctor Approved: Generating Medically Accurate Skin Disease Images through AI-Expert Feedback

layout.note: Three full-bleed tinted panels: (a) blue across the top, (b) green bottom-left and (c) pink bottom-right, each titled on a speckled grey strip. Each panel is a left-to-right chain of icons with captions beneath and photos at the ends. A long dashed arrow runs from the score cards at the top right of (a) down to the fine-tuning icon in (b), and a green dotted arrow runs from the Enhanced DM in (b) to the generated photo in (c).

lesson: Follow one photo pair through every stage: the same two images reappear in each tinted panel, first with scores, then with thumbs, then as training data, so each stage's input and output are seen on one example. Mark the improved model with the same icon plus a small badge.
